details.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.
details.name: Game of Thrones

values.overview: Lord Ned Stark is troubled by disturbing reports form a Night's Watch deserter; King Robert arrives at Winterfell.
values.title: Winter Is Coming

values.overview: The Lannisters plot to ensure Bran's silence; Jon and Tyrion head to the Wall; Ned faces a family crisis en route to King's Landing.
values.title: The Kingsroad

values.overview: Jon impresses Tyrion at Castle Black; Ned confronts his past and future at King's Landing; Daenerys finds herself at odds with Viserys.
values.title: Lord Snow

values.overview: Ned probes Arryn's death; Jon takes measures to protect Sam; Tyrion is caught in the wrong place.
values.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things

values.overview: Ned refuses an order from the King; Tyrion escapes one perilous encounter, only to find himself in another.
values.title: The Wolf and the Lion

values.overview: Ned makes a controversial decree; Tyrion confesses to his 'crimes'; Viserys receives final payment for Daenerys.
values.title: A Golden Crown

values.overview: Ned confronts Cersei about her secrets; Jon takes his Night's Watch vows; Drogo promises to lead the Dothraki to King's Landing.
values.title: You Win or You Die

values.overview: The Lannisters press their advantage over the Starks; Robb rallies his father's northern allies and heads south to war.
values.title: The Pointy End

values.overview: Ned makes a fateful decision; Robb takes a prized prisoner; Dany finds her reign imperiled.
values.title: Baelor

values.overview: A new king rises in the North; a Khaleesi finds new hope.
values.title: Fire and Blood

details.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.
details.name: Game of Thrones

values.overview: Tyrion arrives to save Joffrey's crown from threats old and new; Daenerys searches for allies and water in the Red Waste.
values.title: The North Remembers

values.overview: Arya shares a secret with a familiar recruit; a scout returns to Dany with disturbing news; Theon comes home to the Iron Islands.
values.title: The Night Lands

values.overview: Tyrion roots out a spy; Catelyn meets a new king and queen; Bran dreams; Theon drowns.
values.title: What Is Dead May Never Die

values.overview: Catelyn tries to save two kings from themselves; Tyrion practices coercion; Robb meets a foreigner; Dany finds her ally.
values.title: Garden of Bones

values.overview: The Baratheon rivalry ends; Tyrion learns of Cersei's secret weapon; Dany suffers a loss; Arya collects a debt she didn't know was owed.
values.title: The Ghost of Harrenhal

values.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.
values.title: The Old Gods and the New

values.overview: Jaime meets a distant relative; Dany receives an invitation; Theon leads a search party; Jon loses his way in the wilderness.
values.title: A Man Without Honor

values.overview: Theon holds down the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davros approach their destination.
values.title: The Prince of Winterfell

values.overview: Tyrion and the Lannisters fight for their lives as Stannis’ fleet assaults King’s Landing.
values.title: Blackwater

values.overview: Tyrion wakes up in a new world; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself.
